svg.title: x402 failure: the signed recipient does not match payTo
svg.desc: Sequence diagram: x402 failure: the signed recipient does not match payTo. 3 participants: Client (agent), Resource server, and Facilitator. 5 steps, 1 crossing a trust boundary. Based on x402 v2.0 (2025-12-09). Step 1: Client (agent) to Client (agent): Sign to an unexpected address. Step 2: Client (agent) to Resource server: Retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. Step 3: Resource server to Facilitator: POST /verify. This step crosses a trust boundary. Step 4: Facilitator to Resource server: Return isValid false (recipient mismatch). Step 5: Resource server to Client (agent): 402 with a fresh PAYMENT-REQUIRED.
